snippet.title: Sagas of Lumin   Elos Games and Arts
snippet.description:
Take to the skies and ground in Sagas of Lumin. Ride your dragon with full manual control—dive, climb, hover, turn and unleash fire breath in visceral aerial battles. When you land, engage in precision combat using melee weapons, magic spells and steampunk firearms.  ￼

Explore floating islands in a fractured world where your choices shape the narrative. Build your legend in a story-rich RPG that blends dragon flight and grounded action.  ￼

Wishlist now on Steam and prepare for Early Access in Q1 2026.
